cases.name: transpose_compose
cases.scope: One written operand order of the catalog equation, under the algebraic arithmetic model; source numerical policy is not executed.

cases.name: broadcast_add
cases.scope: Only binary addition, equal base shapes, identical broadcast maps and added extents; excludes other elementwise functions and scalar expansion.

cases.name: broadcast_multiply
cases.scope: Only binary multiplication, equal base shapes, identical maps and added extents.

cases.name: scalar_broadcast_reverse
cases.scope: Only the reverse member of the parameterized indexing schema; input broadcast map is empty.

cases.name: scalar_broadcast_transpose
cases.scope: Only a rank-two transpose with permutation [1,0] and scalar broadcast.

cases.name: reduce_negate
cases.scope: Only sum with implicit zero initializer, matching the catalog arithmetic case.

cases.name: reduce_compose
cases.scope: Rank-three sum, inner axis 1 then outer axis 1; symbolic extents. Does not cover arbitrary combiners/initializers.

cases.name: reduce_transpose
cases.scope: Rank-two transpose [1,0], sum over output axis 0, implicit zero initializer.

cases.name: reverse_compose_disjoint
cases.scope: Rank-two disjoint lists [0] and [1]; probes a case beyond identical-list cancellation.

cases.name: reverse_add_scalar
cases.scope: Only addition and a scalar broadcast; tests the compound rule directly, not a two-rule sequence.

cases.name: slice_compose
cases.scope: Rank-one, positive-size, unit-stride slices with an explicit computed start.

cases.name: slice_reverse
cases.scope: Rank-one, positive-size, unit-stride slice of a reversed axis; explicit reflected start.

cases.name: dot_associate
cases.scope: Ordinary rank-two matrix products without batch axes; every attribute is reused explicitly.

cases.name: dot_transpose_output
cases.scope: Rank-two matrix product, output transpose [1,0]; explicit swapped contraction attributes.

cases.name: dot_move_reverse
cases.scope: Rank-one inner product; reversal of its sole contracting axis; no free/batch axes.

cases.name: reduce_compose_leading
cases.scope: Rank-three sum with inner axis 0 then outer axis 0; implicit zero initializer. Compared with the nonleading-axis case.

cases.name: slice_compose_zero_starts
cases.scope: Rank-one, positive-size, unit-stride slices with both starts zero. Copies outer attributes; avoids computed constructors.

cases.name: broadcast_compose_append
cases.scope: Arbitrary input rank, broadcasts only append new dimensions; concatenates new extents explicitly.

cases.name: dot_swap_operands
cases.scope: Rank-two matrix product. Proves the identity for any captured X/Y; does not implement parameter-like policy screening.

cases.name: dot_no_contraction
cases.scope: Rank-one operands, no batches or contractions; same-type ideal arithmetic, no conversions.

cases.name: dot_reduce_product
cases.scope: Rank-one inner product to multiply then sum; same-type ideal arithmetic, no widened accumulation.

cases.name: dot_reduce_batch
cases.scope: Rank-one batched product reduced over its sole batch axis; no remaining output axes.

cases.name: expr_reverse_compose_general
cases.scope: General symmetric difference computed with existing list builtins; no auto.

cases.name: expr_slice_compose_general
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank unit-stride composition; explicit metadata arithmetic and comprehensions.

cases.name: expr_slice_reverse_general
cases.scope: Arbitrary-rank positive-size strided slice; explicit reflected starts. Empty output cases can be handled separately.

cases.name: expr_convolution_scale_filter_bias
cases.scope: One spatial dimension with fixed kernel/output feature positions. Proves expression of explicit scale broadcasts and convolution attribute reuse; source constant and numerical-policy conditions remain in the catalog.

cases.name: catalog_elementwise_log_power
cases.scope: Scalar literal instance; source conditions retained in the catalog. Local HLO select requires the predicate and both branches to have the same shape.

cases.name: catalog_elementwise_compare_selected_mask
cases.scope: Scalar literal instance; source conditions retained in the catalog. Local HLO select requires the predicate and both branches to have the same shape.

cases.name: catalog_elementwise_compare_max
cases.scope: Written operand/opcode variant under the catalog conditions.

cases.name: catalog_elementwise_compare_min
cases.scope: Written operand/opcode variant under the catalog conditions.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_divide_broadcast
cases.scope: Scalar Y broadcast to an arbitrary output shape.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_multiply_constant_into_broadcast
cases.scope: Scalar factor C is a captured scalar; literal-only profitability does not affect the identity.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_transpose
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_slice_broadcast_only
cases.scope: Rank-one X maps to axis zero; only newly created axes are sliced.

cases.name: catalog_broadcast_slice_broadcast
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.

cases.name: catalog_indexing_slice_singleton_stride
cases.scope: Arbitrary tensor shapes under the catalog arithmetic/applicability assumptions.

cases.name: catalog_dot_transpose_both_operands
cases.scope: Rank-two matrix transposes, no batches.

cases.name: catalog_dot_move_broadcast
cases.scope: One broadcast-created contraction axis; replacement dot is an outer product.

cases.name: catalog_dot_slice_output
cases.scope: Rank-two dot with arbitrary output starts, sizes and positive strides.

cases.name: catalog_dot_reduce_output_free
cases.scope: Reduce the left free axis of a rank-two dot; implicit sum initializer zero.

cases.name: catalog_dot_scalar_multipliers
cases.scope: Scalar factor pulled from a rank-two f32 dot; source constant/profitability screening is outside the algebraic identity.

cases.name: catalog_reduction_broadcast_original_axes
cases.scope: Sum specialization; rank-one base and one broadcast-created axis.
